steps.desc: Add a verbatim full-record passthrough emit mode to the mapper/runner (emit the whole record element, not a fields subset). Default mapped-subset mode unchanged.

Per-emitting-step envelope selector: verbatim (inject nothing) | typed_wrapper ({type,data}) | source_type_prefix ({sourceType, ...record}), + optional templated extra metadata fields (e.g. recommendation_reference: {{rec_id}}). Profile model + validation.
tenable-io.yaml emits verbatim full records (no wrapper/sourceType/correlation injection) matching TenableIo{Assets,Findings}ChunkProcessor.
defender-vm.yaml: machines/software → typed_wrapper; vulns/changes/recommendations/recVulns → source_type_prefix with native sourceType values; recVulns adds recommendationReference={{rec_id}}.

Complete defender-vm.yaml to native collection scope: $filter=lastSeen ge <base_date> + base-date logic, vuln-changes stage (SoftwareVulnerabilityChangesByMachine, 14d lookback), correct native endpoints/stages per DefenderVmUrlBuilder. Keep next_url (no new strategy).

New in-process tests: verbatim passthrough emits FULL record; typed_wrapper shape; source_type_prefix shape incl. templated recommendation_reference; mapped-subset mode unchanged. Build clean; full suite green (52 prior + new).

Parity note mapping each native formatter shape → the YAML reproducing it (file:line citations); explicitly list the 3 deferred vendors (cortex-xdr, crowdstrike-falcon, qualys) as not-yet-native-exact.
